refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoOperationSubtract function calculates the cumulative difference of the values passed in argv, that it, it starts with argv[0] and subtracts each value from argv[1] to argv[argc-1] where argc is the number of values passed.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: SilikoOperationSubtract returns a pointer to an object representing the result of the subtraction operation.

refsection.title: Conformance
refsection.para: The SilikoOperationSubtract function conforms to Siliko Core’s interface for pure functions and can be installed into a SilikoEngine if wrapped with SilikoPureFunctionCreate.
